newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE stocks mark time in lacklustre year-end trade.
newsitem.headline: UAE stocks mark time in lacklustre year-end trade.

text.p: The unofficial United Arab Emirates stock market ended the week to Thursday stable in lacklustre trade, with the National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) 27-share edging up 7.62 points to 2,475.03, brokers said.
They said trade was quiet as investors, waiting for year-end results for direction, stayed away.

For the seventh week running, market leader Etisalat was unchanged at 955. Al-Khazna Insurance extended its recent fall, ending at 280 dirhams from 295 a week earlier, while Dubai Investment Co was steady at 13.5 dirhams.
The Oman and Emirates Investment Co was also unchanged at 10 dirhams, the Abu Dhabi National Insurance Co rose five dirhams to 1,045, while Emirates Insurance Co added five dirhams to 620.
Among banks, NBAD kept to its firmer trend, gaining five dirhams to close at 440. The Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank added 10 dirhams to end at 340.
